description: Look up the live DNS of a domain: NS, A/AAAA/CNAME, MX, SPF, DMARC, CAA (climbing to the parent zone) and DNSSEC status, with plain-English findings. Use it for a DNS inventory or to debug resolution; use check_email_auth for a deeper SPF/DMARC/DKIM/MTA-STS review. Queries Cloudflare DNS-over-HTTPS (1.1.1.1) at call time; read-only, nothing is stored. Costs $0.01 USDC per call via x402 (payment goes in _meta["x402/payment"]); invalid input or an upstream failure returns an error and is not charged.

domain.description: Hostname or URL, e.g. example.com or https://www.example.com/path
